Second, moving var byDomain below the filter loop was rejected because var is function-scoped and hoisted, so the name stays in lexical scope either way and the move buys only a runtime TypeError while reading as a stranded declaration in a deliberately ES5/UMD no-build file. Third, no dead code exists: inputCount, retainedCount and collapsedCount are asserted by tests/portfolio-foundation.unit.mjs:631-643 and the function is exported at :4949 and consumed by three carriers.
